book.name: Job
book.title: Job Wotfo Gudbala Pipul Abum Trabul?

content: Nomo enibodi gin tok adbala langa YAWEI
Wal Job bin tok langa YAWEI,
“Ai sabi na nomo enibodi gin dalim yu wanim yu gin dum, dumaji oni yu na garram pawa blanga dum ebrijing yu wandim dum.
Yubin askim mi wotfo aibin oldei tok dumaji ai sabi oni lilbit. Trubala aibin tokabat loda ting weya ai nomo bin sabi.
Yubin dalim mi blanga jidan kwaitbala en irrim en ensim detlot kwestjan yubin askim mi.
“Basdam aibin oni irrimbat wanim najalot pipul bin tok blanga yu, bat tudei na aibin luk langa yu garram main ronwan ai.
Mi rili sheim miselp na en mi brabli sori. En blanga tharran na mi jidanbat iya langa das en eshis.” Lagijat na Job bin tok.
YAWEI bin tok adbalawei langa ol detlot fren blanga Job

Bambai na wen YAWEI bin binij tok langa Job, imbin tok langa Elifas, “Mi brabli wail langa yu en langa yu fren dubala, dumaji yumob nomo bin tok trubalawei blanga mi. Wanim main wekinmen Job bin oldei tok, im trubala.

Wal yumob garra deigim sebenbala buligi, en sebenbala dediwan ship langa main wekinmen Job blanga gibit sekrifais ofring blanga yumob langa det teibul blanga ofring, blanga meigim mi gudbinji. En Job garra prei blanga yumob, en ai garra ensim im preya, en ai kaan panishim yumob blanga ola siliwan ting weya yumob bin tok.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
Wal Elifas, Bilded en Sofara bin dum wanim YAWEI bin dalim olabat blanga dum, en imbin ensim det preya blanga Job.
Dijan stori binijap gudbalawei
Afta na wen Job bin prei blanga im thribala fren, YAWEI bin meigim Job jidan mowa ritjwan langa wen imbin jidan basdam.

En Job bin abum bigiswan padi en ol im braja, sista en ol im frenmob bin ol kaman. Olabat bin dalim im deibin ol brabli nogudbinji blanga det trabul weya YAWEI bin dum langa im en deibin ol gibit im silba en gol.
Wal YAWEI bin brabli kain langa Job, mowa den bifo. Imbin gibit im 14,000 ship, 6,000 kemul, 2,000 buligi, en 1,000 dongki.
En Job bin abum sebenbala san, en thribala doda.
Imbin gulum im bigiswan doda Jemima en det sekanwan Kesaiya en det lilwan Kerenapak.
Deibin mowa purdiwan langa najalot gel langa tharran kantri. En Job bin sherimat ebrijing blanga im langa im dodamob en sanmob du.
Wal Job bin jidan laibala blanga naja 140 yiya, en imbin luk im bigininimob en im grenkidmob bin abumbat ronwan biginini du.
En wen Job bin redi blanga dai imbin brabli olmen. Binij na.
